title: Ikimenyetso kiri hagati y'amabuye
intro: Mu gihugu aho imisozi yari yarashushanyijwemo amazu, intumwa yahageze ifite ikimenyetso cy'igitangaza kivuye kuri Allah. Abantu basabye gihamya, maze bahabwa ikiremwa giturutse ku rutare rukomeye. Ariko ubwibone bwabo bwatumye banga umuburo, biyemeza iherezo ryabo.
clues: Noherejwe mu bantu babaga mu mazu acukuwe mu misozi.
Bansabye kuzana ikimenyetso, maze nkora ingamiya mu rutare.
Nabategetse kureka ingamiya ikanywa ku buntu kandi ntibayigireho ingaruka mbi.
Banze kumvira batema ingamiya, birengagiza umuburo wanjye.
Natangaje ko igihano kizatangwa nyuma y'iminsi itatu.
Mu gitondo, igisasu gikomeye cyarabashenye, ariko njye n'abambari banjye twarakijijwe.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Gusaba ingamiya y'ingore iva mu rutare
Gusaba inkoni kugira ngo ibe inzoka
trial.answer: Gusaba ingamiya y'ingore iva mu rutare

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
